sloka: एह्येहीत्यब्रवीद्रामो लक्ष्मणं परवीरहा ।सस्वजे स्नेहगाढं च बाष्पपार्याकुलेक्षणः ।। ६.१०२.३८ ।।
transliteration: ehyehītyabravīdrāmo lakṣmaṇaṁ paravīrahā ।sasvaje snehagāḍhaṁ ca bāṣpapāryākulekṣaṇaḥ ।। 6.102.38 ।।

translations.english: The son of wind god, having revealed it like that, Sushena the leader of the Vanaras uprooted the herb and took out.
